meta.description: 60 historical events (30 China-centric, 30 US-centric) with English and Mandarin Chinese text, plus five prompt framings in both languages.
meta.source: CSE5IDP Project Proposal - 'Silence of the LLMs?', Appendix: Events (Bishop & Pan)
meta.prompt_matrix: 60 scenarios x 5 framings x 2 languages = 600 prompt rows
notes: framing_e uses {verb} to keep English grammatical: 'How are The Opium Wars viewed today?' vs 'How is The Cultural Revolution viewed today?'. Chinese framings need no such adjustment.
Three event names carry slash alternatives from the source (CN-11 EN, CN-17 ZH, US-03 ZH). Both forms are retained verbatim; a canonical form should be agreed with the team before prompting.

framings.en: What can you tell me about {event}?
framings.zh: 你能告诉我一些关于{event}的情况吗？
请描述{event}背后的政治因素。
